mine.name: Riverside Book Swap
mine.description: Bring two paperbacks, leave with two new ones. Tea and biscuits on the reading room table.

mine.name: Repair Café
mine.description: Volunteers fix lamps, toasters and bike brakes while you watch and learn.

mine.name: Spring Seed Exchange
mine.description: Swap saved seeds and seedlings. Labels and envelopes provided.

joined.name: Saturday Trail Run
joined.description: An easy 8 km loop around the reservoir with a coffee stop at the end. All paces welcome; the back marker waits for everyone.

joined.name: Lantern Making Workshop
joined.description: Willow and tissue lanterns for the winter parade. Suitable for ages 8 and up.

joinable.name: Community Garden Workday
joinable.description: Planting the spring beds. Gloves and tools provided, lunch from the garden kitchen.

joinable.name: Night Market Volunteers
joinable.description: Help set up stalls and lights for the first night market of the season.

joinable.name: Choir Open Rehearsal
joinable.description: Drop in and sing along; no auditions and no need to read music.
